extension_contract.governance: Adding a type such as defect requires a governed registry entry, identity rule, lifecycle compatibility decision, machine-readable classification validation, documentation, and tests. Unregistered or definition-free identifiers fail closed.

see_also: A consuming or adopting project may maintain its own project-specific Definition-of-Done registry, outside Dual Hat's portable source, that carries each of this registry's types' closure-time Definition of Done per GOVERNING_PRINCIPLES.md rule 31, and that may also cover governed types intentionally out of this registry's scope (never opened via a sealed work order); such a project-specific registry documents its own relationship to this file for the boundary.

capability.classification_rule: product_increment must be true; independently bounded governance_contract_change must be false; tightly coupled governance may use extension_classification.coupled_governance_change
capability.semantic_owner: bounded product, runtime, data, workflow, or operational increment

gov.classification_rule: governance_contract_change must be true and product_increment must not be true
gov.semantic_owner: independently bounded governance or framework change
